citations.text: Hanisch, S., & Eirdosh, D. (2023). Behavioral science and education for sustainable development: Towards metacognitive competency. Sustainability, 15(9), 7413.

en.general: Practice with the Noticing Tool: telling inner behavior (thoughts, feelings) from outer behavior (actions), and judging what function each serves, for example whether it avoids discomfort or serves a value. The paper treats it as a way to practise awareness, acceptance and re-orienting behavior.

examples: Filling in a matrix of inner and outer behavior for a hard situation.
